id: title:Gilbert09:keep a source rollout window out of error tracking

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion workflow: distinguishes rollout gaps from implementation defects to prevent false-positive error tracking.
review.reason: The change introduces a new exception class `SourceExtractionNotImplementedError` and its usage in warehouse ingestion sources (`SimpleSource`, `ResumableSource`) and the ingestion workflow (`import_data_sync.py`). This allows warehouse ingestion workers to distinguish between a missing implementation and a real defect, preventing false-positive error tracking during source roll.
review.uncertainty: The complete implementation and dependency graph are not fully demonstrated; the exact customer-facing benefit and complete failure handling path are not fully demonstrated.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the full implementation of the warehouse ingestion workflow or the complete dependency graph, so while the change is clearly a rollout-guard for warehouse sources, the exact customer-facing benefit and the complete failure handling path are not fully demonstrated. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new exception class SourceExtractionNotImplementedError and replaces NotImplementedError in SimpleSource and ResumableSource with this new exception, while also adding a NonReportableError wrapper and a customer-facing message.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows warehouse ingestion workers to distinguish between a missing implementation and a real defect, preventing false-positive error tracking during source rollouts.

observations.behavior: Changes the exception raised by SimpleSource and ResumableSource.source_for_pipeline from NotImplementedError to SourceExtractionNotImplementedError.
observations.posthog_connection: Updates warehouse ingestion to use the new exception, distinguishing rollout gaps from implementation defects.

observations.behavior: Adds import of SourceExtractionNotImplementedError in import_data_sync.py.
observations.posthog_connection: Makes the new exception available for use in the warehouse ingestion workflow.
